eclipse_model: Uniform circular discs in tangent plane; no atmospheric refraction, limb darkening or spatially varying penumbra.
earthshine_model: Lambert sphere, geometric albedo 0.367; retarded Earth illumination and topocentric phase approximation excludes atmospheric and surface variation and eclipses
geometry_limit: Anchor height is the recorded center sample, if available, otherwise zero; frame realization uncertainty and terrain outside the mesh are not modeled.
visibility_limit: The local terrain casts shadows, but distant terrain and the lunar globe outside the mesh are not modeled as occluders.
blender_direction_frame: Site04 south-polar stereographic plane, x increasing easting, y increasing northing, z up
blender_frame_limit: Single-anchor rotation on a flat projected grid; lunar curvature and spatially varying orientation are not represented.
